title: Nuclear Detonation Timeline "1945-1998"
summary: A timeline visualization plotting the 2053 nuclear tests and detonations from 1945 to 1998 on a world map, with sound marking each blast. It conveys the pace of the nuclear arms race.
why: HN links it as a reference for the history and distribution of nuclear tests, and occasionally as an example of audio data presentation.

quote.text: There is a timeline form 1945 to 1998 of all the nuclear detonations recorded
